description: WP-G3 Codex: Orks (11e) RUNNIN' WIV DA HERD (Painboss) keyword swap as the player sees it. Fixture ork11e_g3_herd: the Painboss is attached to Squighog Boyz A (MOUNTED). Movement phase: hovering the Painboss and pressing I opens its datasheet — KEYWORDS show MOBILE and MOUNTED and no INFANTRY (the rules engine reads the same keywords). Setup privilege: every Squighog model is removed (destroyed) without an action. Then real clicks — select Beast Snagga Boyz, 'Remain Still', 'Confirm Movement Mode' — run an ordinary action; the after-action sync reverts the swap, and the reopened datasheet shows INFANTRY again (no MOBILE / MOUNTED).

steps.comment: movement_phase_start window (if any) — not under test
attached to a MOUNTED unit: no INFANTRY, has MOBILE and MOUNTED (RulesEngine keyword check too)
setup privilege (see description): the Squighog Boyz are destroyed
steps.script:
for m in GameState.state.units["U_SQUIGHOG_BOYZ_A"].models:
	m["alive"] = false
	m["current_wounds"] = 0
return true

steps.comment: bodyguard destroyed: the swap is reverted by the after-action sync
